method_selection: all 3 fixed nonboosting baselines contrasted with 17 fixed non-duplicate boosting configurations; one global best nonboosting named only descriptively by equal-family AUROC pooled equally across designs
paired_contrasts: RN-naive and CS-naive for 5 engines; every fixed nonboosting 003-005 versus each fixed naive/RN/CS/AdaPU/PU-GB comparator
rank_ties: average ranks after rounding scenario means to 12 decimals solely for numerical ties
scope: 40 simulation settings per design; supervised references separate; no real or prior-misspecification pooling
